caseStudy.water-access-kampala.title: Eggyabikiro ku amazzi ebiba nga tekikwatagana
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.summary: Tegereza kye abantu ba mu kitundu bategeezako ku eggyabikiro ku amazzi mu Kampala
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.imageAlt: Eizibu etonoodde era abantu bangi ku mabbali g'olusuku
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.1: Mu ddalaako byonna mu Kampala, eggyabikiro ku amazzi ebikaala okutenguka olw'enkakisa y'olunaku. Ebyakwanga, okukata kwa amazzi n'ebikwata ku bulungi bw'amazzi, byakabuwaza abasaawa butwalala, nga buli kikwata ku ekifo eri ha efulaaza n'emitandukwa ewaliwo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.2: Mu nkozeseera ya Community Water Watch, WatchTower ekeeza ekina kya abantu okujja ebizibu bya bino mu ennimi eziba bulungi nnyo ku bo, kikaba kikwata nga ebyatuyo by'abaako birinza okujja kitundu mu ekipfoto kinene ekiro n'okutegeera abantu ba mu kitundu byaliwo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.3: Wekuuma tetwola enakuzi tungi era toyige buli kiseera amazzi g'egoola.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.4: Olubikkunju lumu lulekera olunaku lw'omuntu aluwadde. Naye nga ebizibu bwe bikiika buli kiseera, mu bibo ebisingawo era mu budde butwalala, byawulira ebisingawo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.5: Community Water Watch yalonda okussereza ebyatuyo bya bino hamwe era okubibola bulungi okutegeerezeka.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.6: Tegereza ebwo mazuuka ga kisinga gasobola okutwalukawo
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.7: Amazzi g'amabanja gali amagala nnyo ku zimba ez'obuzimbi n'okutwala mu mmeeza. Naye tekakata buli kiseera okujja ekikwata ku kiki eggyabikiro ekitalaba okutwala amazzi ekikwata ku nzu n'emu kitundu.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.8: Abantu bagambaika enakuzi ezitalaba amazzi, ebalii eziryali okutambula okunoonya enjaro enda, enkyukakyuka mu bulungi bw'amazzi n'engero ezikwata ku byakwanga by'okutengula buli kiseera k'omulimu.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.9: Okujja kwa abantu mu kitundu kukola lutundu lumu olwa k'ebimukiro; olwo gisinza ku ebyo abantu balaba era batuuka mu mbuto zaabwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.10.a: Eizibu etonoodde era abantu bangi ku mabbali g'olusuku
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.12: Community Water Watch yakoresa WatchTower okuwanyoola okujja mu nkozeseera era mu bibo ebisingawo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.14: Abantu baakola okuteekateeka ebizibu mu ennimi eziba bulungi nnyo ku bo, kikaba kikwata nga ebyatuyo by'abaako tebilu okulolagulwa nga banza okugabikwa.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.16: Ebizibu biakola okugabikwa mu bubikuro oba mu ddoboozi, kikaba kikwaata abantu engeri ebisingawo ez'okulondola ekiba ekigwa.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.18: WatchTower yakoona okuyika, okulolagula n'okufula ebizibu, kikaba kikwata nga ebizibu ebiriwako mu ennimi ez'enjawulo ezisinga za bulungi nnyo hamwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.20: Ebizibu byakola okulaba mu Ekifo, mu Budde era n'ekizibu, kikaba kikwata nga emitondo g'ebizibu ebijja buli kiseera gumu gibika okunoonyereza.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.22: Ebikwata ku muntu nnongo n'ekifo ekikwata ku budde busoboka ku lwaki biratwala era okuzikolagana bulungi, okuyimiriza abantu abakwasikiriza ebizibu.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.24: Nga bwe ebizibu bali bakwata, ebyatuyo by'abaako bimaze okukolagana.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.27: Ebizibu byali bikolebwa mu bitundu byonna mu Kampala, okukali mu nsozi ebisinga, ebikulu biri ku kukoleseka amazzi, okutwala mu mmeeza kw'akafu n'ebuliungi bw'amazzi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.29: Kuva mu bimukiro okugenda mu mmeeza
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.30: Okutega eri ng'omuw-IR bwa buli kiseera nga ebiragwa by'abantu ba mu kitundu bisoboka okulwanya engeri ebigenda mu maaso.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.31: Ebimukiro ebikwatagana ku Community Water Watch bisobola okuyimiriza enkolagana ez'okukubwa mu kitundu, mu makunzi era n'ebikwata ku ddalaako ekirala abakola ku eggyabikiro ku amazzi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.32: Ebizibu bisobola okuyamba n'obuwere bw'ekizibu, obulwanya, okutegeezesa, okuyimiriza n'okuggyeeko ku bamala.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.34: Abantu abali bannere n'ekizibu balobola buli kiseera okutegeera ebintu ebikwata ku kizibu eby'amazuuka g'akwegerwa yero teggwa okulwa ku kimu.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.35: Okujja mu ssomero kwa abantu ku kitundu kukwaaza ekina kuyimiriza ebyatuyo bya bino nga bigaba.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.36: Nga abantu basobola kujja mu ennimi zaabwe n'ebizibu byabwe bisobola kutegeerezeka, kukolagana n'okulaba hamwe, eddoboozi ly'omuntu limu lisobola kutandika obutegeereza bumaze ku biki ekigwanga ku mmeeza y'ensi.
caseStudy.changing-seasons-everyday-life: Nga empeera ezikwatagana ziika buli kiseera k'omulimu
Engeri eddoboozi ly'abantu ba mu kitundu lyekuuma kumiriza ekipfoto kimaze okumanyuka ku embeera y'obudde ekikwatagana.
Enzu ezisajidde na malangi amaka oluvu, ezizingirizidwe ku buzibwe
